### Josiah’s Passover
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/josiahs-passover
Passage: 2 Chronicles 35:1-19
Points:
- True reformation requires both putting away false worship and actively restoring biblical truth.
- Josiah reinstated the long-neglected Passover according to Scripture with extraordinary generosity.
- The celebration was observed on an unprecedented scale, unmatched since the days of Samuel.
- Returning exiles were reminded that God desires lavish, joyful celebration of redemption even amid trials.
- Christians are called to celebrate their redemption in Christ with deep joy rather than austere gloom.
